decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully records the revised drawing formats, including PDF, DWG, and native SolidWorks SLDDRW; no additional update or top-level key removal is required.
The model-format change does not alter the existing PDF-first confirmation requirement or its generic post-confirmation export action.
The dimensional instructions are a separate decision in the source message and are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and RESUME Events.
Changing final 3D model file formats does not change the required sliding-mandrel keyway geometry.
The deliverable-format decision does not resolve or modify the thread-relief groove requirement or its unresolved width.
The selected model formats do not change the bushing location, attachment, guidance, fit, or motion arrangement.
The final model file package does not modify the locking-thread geometry or required bushing-space length.
The model-format change does not affect the instruction to omit the main-shaft keyway at cross section C-C.
The source decision changes file deliverables only and does not alter retention of the bushing or sliding-mandrel holes.
The required 120-degree hole-axis spacing remains valid independently of the selected model file formats.
Changing the model deliverable formats does not modify assembly-aligned drawing numbering.
The final file-format decision has no effect on the specified materials for the bushing and other parts.
